title: Quantity
description: A physical quantity in internal units. Blueprint v3.1 §4.1 requires physical meaning, dimensions, display unit, role, bounds, nominal and an uncertainty reference; ADR 0001 D1 adds the explicit `kind` and fixes the dimension order and the SI storage rule. JSON Schema cannot reject NaN or infinity once a document is decoded into Python floats, and it cannot check that `dimension` and `unit` are the ones registered for `kind`: those are `process_runtime.units.check_quantity`, which every round-trip fixture runs alongside this schema.

value.description: Magnitude in `unit`. Must be finite; see check_quantity (ADR 0001 D1.5).

unit.description: The unprefixed SI unit registered for `kind` in schemas/units.json (ADR 0001 D1.1). Display units belong in `display_unit`.

meaning.description: What the number is physically, in words. Blueprint §4.1 'physical meaning'.

role.description: How the solver treats it: a fixed specification, a free variable, a declared decision variable, or a value reconstructed from a solution.

bounds.description: Validity bounds. A trial state outside them is an invalid trial state, reported and never clipped inside a residual or Jacobian evaluation (ADR 0001 D2.3).

nominal.description: Registered physical nominal used to build scales. Scales never come from an iterate value (ADR 0001 D3.5).

display_unit.description: Presentation only; conversion metadata, never the stored value.

uncertainty_ref.description: Reference to an uncertainty record. `null` states explicitly that none is recorded; it is not an implicit claim of exactness.

provenance.description: Where the number comes from. Required for every ComponentRecord parameter.

dimension.description: SI exponents in the fixed order (length, mass, time, temperature, amount, current, luminous_intensity) — ADR 0001 D1.2.

kind.description: ADR 0001 D1.3, plus `molar_mass` for ComponentRecord.molecular_weight and the two kinds `molar_heat_capacity` and `molar_volume` that the SYN-001 ComponentRecord parameters c_p and v_i need; the latter two are a P01 addition awaiting Fable's confirmation (docs/progress.md, 'Opus -> Fable, P01 handoff'). `temperature` and `temperature_difference` share a dimension and are not interchangeable.
